description: Normative fact-export-v1 schema for the outcomes table. Exports historical git evidence extracted strictly from session records or workspace snapshots (D4c; never live git subprocesses during replay). Producer exports raw historical evidence only; the outcome proxy is computed exclusively in Enterprise (MVP plan §2 Decision 5, EN6b, F4).

base_commit_hmac.description: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the session's initial/base git commit SHA when observed. Never a raw 40-char git SHA (F13).

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13); raw 40-char git SHAs are rejected.
x_justification.why_present: Allows EN6b to compare base_commit_hmac vs head_commit_hmac to determine whether the session produced commits without exposing raw commit hashes.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether base_commit_hmac is non-null ('observed') vs null ('single_point_only' when only a single commit point was captured, 'not_observed' when git commit state is absent).
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes single-point commit captures (e.g. session start only) from completely missing git state.

branch_name_hmac.description: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the normalized git branch name when on a named branch. Null on detached HEAD or when branch state is unobserved.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff branch_status == 'named_branch'; null when branch_status in ['detached_head', 'not_observed'].
x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13); prevents developer names or ticket titles in branch names from leaking.
x_justification.why_present: Groups sessions operating on the same branch for EN6b survival/rework proxy computation.

branch_status.description: Explicit git HEAD branch state governing branch_name_hmac (AGENTS.md §3.3).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether branch_name_hmac is non-null ('named_branch') vs null ('detached_head' or 'not_observed').
x_justification.why_present: Separates detached-HEAD worktrees (e.g. CI/meshloop workers) from missing branch metadata.

canonical_harness.description: Canonical harness identifier from the closed link-id-v1 vocabulary.

x_justification.why_present: Supports per-harness git evidence coverage and EN6b outcome proxy stratification.

evidence_source.description: Historical artifact surface from which the git evidence was extracted. Live git subprocess execution during replay is prohibited (D4c, AGENTS.md Invariant 4).

x_justification.why_present: Certifies that git evidence came from historical session/telemetry records rather than live filesystem mutation (MVP plan §2 Decision 5, D4c).

evidence_status.description: Overall completeness of historical git evidence in this record.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs missing_reason and whether all four git component statuses are observed ('observed_full'), a non-empty subset is observed ('observed_partial'), or none are observed ('missing').
x_justification.why_present: Provides an explicit denominator classifier for EN6b proxy eligibility and D5 coverage reporting.

head_commit_hmac.description: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the observed HEAD git commit SHA. Never a raw 40-char git SHA (F13).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff head_commit_status == 'observed'; null iff head_commit_status == 'not_observed'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13); raw 40-char git SHAs are rejected.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks the commit state reached by the session and replaceable within a generation as subsequent commits occur in the session.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether head_commit_hmac is non-null ('observed') vs null ('not_observed').
x_justification.why_present: Eliminates null ambiguity on HEAD commit digests.

missing_reason.description: Explicit reason code when evidence_status == 'missing'. Null when full or partial git evidence is observed.

x_justification.why_present: Explains whether git evidence is absent because the workspace is not a git repo (AGENTS.md §3.3) or because the harness log omitted git metadata.
Prevents missing git snapshot timestamps from defaulting to epoch 0.

observed_at_us.description: UTC timestamp in microseconds since Unix epoch when the historical git evidence was captured in the session.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff observed_at_status == 'observed'; null iff observed_at_status == 'not_reported'.
x_justification.why_present: Orders git state transitions across sessions for EN6b commit lineage proxy calculation.

outcome_key.description: Globally unique 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 primary key of the historical git evidence record, derived from (session_key, sequence_no).

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Primary key for outcome evidence deduplication and in-generation replacement when later session events update git state.

pseudonym_key_id.description: Identifier of the customer-held HMAC key generation used to pseudonymize identifiers in this row (DE-004, F13).

x_justification.pseudonymization: Key generation label; contains no secret material.
x_justification.why_present: Supports customer-held key rotation across git evidence digests (DE-004).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether repo_remote_hmac is non-null ('observed') vs null ('no_remote_configured' or 'not_observed').
x_justification.why_present: Separates local-only git repositories without an origin remote from missing repository metadata.

repo_remote_hmac.description: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the credential-sanitized canonical git origin URL (AGENTS.md §3.3). Never a raw URL or path.

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest of credential-stripped canonical remote URL under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Correlates git commits across developer workstations working on the same repository without leaking repository names or URLs.

sequence_no.description: 0-based monotonic ordinal of the git evidence checkpoint within the session.

x_justification.why_present: Orders initial vs updated git evidence snapshots within a session.

session_key.description: Foreign key to sessions.session_key (64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256).

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Links historical git evidence to the session that observed it.

source_generation.description: Monotonic positive integer generation of the source extraction state.

x_justification.why_present: Allows an in-progress session's git evidence (e.g. new HEAD commit or worktree state transition) to be replaced in a later snapshot within the same generation (MVP plan §2 Decision 3).

source_id.description: Pseudonymized 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the logical source root.

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Partitions outcome replacement scope by source root.

worktree_state.description: Historical git working-tree cleanliness state when captured in session records.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum with explicit 'unknown' state.
x_justification.why_present: Indicates whether uncommitted modifications remained alongside head_commit_hmac for EN6b proxy confidence scoring.

title: fact-export-v1 outcomes table row
x_invariants: evidence_status == 'missing' <=> (missing_reason != null && remote_status == 'not_observed' && branch_status == 'not_observed' && head_commit_status == 'not_observed' && base_commit_status == 'not_observed')

evidence_status == 'observed_full' <=> (missing_reason == null && remote_status == 'observed' && branch_status == 'named_branch' && head_commit_status == 'observed' && base_commit_status == 'observed')

evidence_status == 'observed_partial' <=> (missing_reason == null && (remote_status == 'observed' || branch_status != 'not_observed' || head_commit_status == 'observed' || base_commit_status == 'observed') && !(remote_status == 'observed' && branch_status == 'named_branch' && head_commit_status == 'observed' && base_commit_status == 'observed'))
